.. py:function:: brain_extraction(image: nvitk.types.Image | numpy.ndarray | Sequence[nvitk.types.Image | numpy.ndarray], *, modality: str = 't1', verbose: bool = False) -> numpy.ndarray

   ANTsPyNet multi-modal brain extraction.

   :param image: One intensity volume, or a sequence of volumes for multi-modal
                 modalities such as ``t1t2infant``.
   :param modality: ANTsPyNet modality string (``t1``, ``t2``, ``flair``, ``mra``, …).
